aiOverview.content: On July 17, 2025, the White House announced that President Donald Trump, age 79, was diagnosed with chronic venous insufficiency (CVI), a common, benign condition where vein valves in the legs struggle to return blood to the heart, causing mild swelling. The diagnosis followed a check-up for leg swelling and hand bruising. chronic venous insufficiency a check-up for leg swelling and hand bruising Key details regarding the diagnosis: Condition: Chronic venous insufficiency (CVI) Chronic venous insufficiency Symptoms & Exam: The diagnosis was made after Doppler ultrasounds Doppler ultrasounds Treatment & Status: The White House described it as a "benign and common condition," stating that Trump remains in "excellent health". a "benign and common condition," Management: It is often managed with compression socks compression socks
